name: PutnamBench
intro: PutnamBench 是 LongCat-Flash-Prover 报告中用于 Putnam 风格高等数学题的评测。
intro_en: PutnamBench is referenced by LongCat-Flash-Prover reports for Putnam-style advanced mathematics problems.
drawio_review_note: reviewed_at=2026-07-18; status=source-reconstructed-awaiting-independent-signoff; scope=PutnamBench paper-aligned bilingual Build Process, source permission, near-paper release drift, current-release drift, language-specific licenses, and source-stage topology contract. Primary evidence is PutnamBench v2 at https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.11214v2 and https://arxiv.org/pdf/2407.11214v2; the reviewed PDF SHA-256 is 0a990ea2dcfe331d4ad1ca87211a50fd8857d6e1c59e106e7b466ad78590f9d5. Official repository evidence is https://github.com/trishullab/PutnamBench. The paper contract is kept authoritative for the paper-aligned flow: 640 William Lowell Putnam Mathematical Competition problems, 640 Lean 4 formalizations, 640 Isabelle formalizations, and 412 Coq formalizations, totaling 1,692 manually constructed formalizations. Original English statements are included with permission from the Mathematical Association of America, and numerical solutions are retained when applicable. Paper Table 2 reports overlapping domain counts of Algebra 253, Analysis 226, Number Theory 107, Geometry 68, Linear Algebra 51, Abstract Algebra 28, Combinatorics 26, Probability 9, and Set Theory 8; these counts are a descriptive evidence inventory rather than a temporal construction step and are not incorrectly treated as a partition of 640. Roughly 60% of the natural-language problems require a closed-form solution in addition to a proof. The authors factor the solution outside the theorem statement to preserve the solution-finding difficulty. Task 1 requires a model to identify the closed-form solution, rewrite it into the theorem statement, and prove correctness. Task 2 provides the theorem statement and solution and asks only for a proof of correctness. The manual team consisted of two doctoral and five undergraduate students with prior mathematics, computer-science, and proof-assistant experience. The paper reports roughly 25 minutes to formalize one problem in one language. It explicitly records the chronological effort as Lean 4 first, then Isabelle, then Coq, while warning that different foundations prevent direct mechanical transfer; the graph therefore labels each stage as manual, language-specific adaptation rather than translation. Each formalization was verified by a second person at least once, with roughly 10 minutes average verification time. The published benchmark then branches into the two factored-solution task settings. The paper's reported formal-proof baseline evaluates Task 2 only: candidate proofs are executed by the relevant formal proof environment, and success is reported with pass@n, meaning at least one certified proof within a budget of n attempts. The paper footnote identifies the actual baseline model as GPT-4o; it uses pass@10 with temperature 0.7. This configuration is shown as a disclosed Task-2 baseline, not a universal requirement for every system and not as a reported Task-1 baseline. Repository drift is intentionally isolated on dashed edges. A near-paper snapshot at commit 93869067a54396f9edb752a57f78960cece8c24c dated 2024-11-04 reports 644 Lean, 640 Isabelle, and 412 Coq files, totaling 1,696, which already differs from the paper's 640 + 640 + 412 = 1,692. The current audited snapshot is pinned to commit 982b29ea89d5bca970a3c6b1ce486a15967b7cb3 and reports competition years 1962 through 2025 with 672 Lean, 640 Isabelle, and 412 Coq formalizations, totaling 1,724. Its README.md SHA-256 is 6a157e86321ea08a11766c18e20d28b6204a73cd5a96285fffc918120c976758. These later counts do not overwrite the NeurIPS 2024 paper contract. The current repository states Apache-2.0 for Lean 4 and Isabelle and MIT for Coq; the Lean and Isabelle LICENSE files share SHA-256 cfc7749b96f63bd31c3c42b5c471bf756814053e847c10f3eb003417bc523d30, while the Coq LICENSE SHA-256 is 3b827918f5519d5f01e0197eedf478049de5cb21bbd91771f60f761fc08b0f0d. Informal statements remain separately bounded by MAA permission. No automatic formalization, mechanical cross-language translation, single global license, non-overlapping category partition, or current-count backport into the paper is inferred. English and Chinese specs have identical semantic IDs, types, sizes, positions, styles, edge endpoints, edge types, edge styles, waypoints, and modules; every secondary edge explicitly sets dashed=true and no edge has a label. Canonical source/spec/architecture and SVG paths remain unchanged; mermaid_flowchart is null and both legacy fallbacks are empty. Strict Draw.io/XML and runtime visual review are required next; replacement formal assets and refreshed paper_aligned registration remain gated on independent reviewer approval.
